sentences.en: As a candidate, I promised we would pass a massive tax cut for the everyday working American families who are the backbone and the heartbeat of our country.
sentences.zh: 作为候选人，我曾承诺，我们将为日常辛勤工作的美国普通家庭通过大规模减税，他们是我们国家的脊梁和心跳。

sentences.en: Wednesday afternoon, President Trump, fresh off what had been a brutal election defeat in Alabama the night before, stood out in the White
sentences.zh: 周三下午，特朗普总统刚刚结束了前一天在阿拉巴马州惨痛的选举失利，便站在白宫

sentences.en: House and delivered what the White House had called a closing argument for the tax reform bill.
sentences.zh: 发表了白宫所谓的税收改革法案的最后陈述。

sentences.en: Jim Tankersley reports on taxes and the economy.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·坦克斯利报道税收和经济。

sentences.en: He was surrounded by families.
sentences.zh: 他被许多家庭环绕着。

sentences.en: Leon and Maria, I would love you to discuss your middle class tax cut a little bit with the millions of people watching right now on television.
sentences.zh: 莱昂和玛丽亚，我很想请你们跟现在正在电视机前观看的数百万观众，稍微讨论一下你们的中产阶级减税政策。

sentences.en: He let them talk about how great this bill would be not just for them, but for their communities.
sentences.zh: 他让他们谈论这项法案不仅对他们自己，而且对他们的社区会有多大帮助。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总统先生。

sentences.en: God bless you.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: And we'll continue to keep praying for you and your team as you move forward and forge ahead with this new future in America.
sentences.zh: 随着你们继续推进并在美国开创这个崭新的未来，我们将继续为你和你的团队祈祷。

sentences.en: God bless you.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: He can be my minister anytime.
sentences.zh: 他随时都可以当我的牧师。

sentences.en: A lot of middle class families don't think this will benefit them personally.
sentences.zh: 许多中产阶级家庭认为这不会让他们个人受益。

sentences.en: Two thirds of the country thinks they will either get a tax increase or no tax cut at all.
sentences.zh: 三分之二的国家认为他们要么会遭遇加税，要么根本没有减税。

sentences.en: So the president here, I think, was trying to give you something relatable, you American taxpayer, to say, hey, here are people
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，这里的总统是想给你们——也就是美国纳税人——一个感同身受的例子，说，嘿，这里有人

sentences.en: who believe they're going to do well from this cut and who, by the way, said very nice things about the president.
sentences.zh: 相信他们能从这次减税中获益，而且顺便说一句，他们对总统说了非常好的话。

sentences.en: And he was very happy to hear those things.
sentences.zh: 他很高兴听到这些话。

sentences.en: Many of your predecessors promised that this reform was coming, but you did it.
sentences.zh: 你的许多前任都承诺过这项改革会到来，但你做到了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: While the president is at the White House with these middle class families giving this final sales speech about the Republican tax plan, what is
sentences.zh: 正当总统在白宫与这些中产阶级家庭一起发表关于共和党税收计划的最后推销演讲时，国会那边的税收计划进展如何？

sentences.en: happening with this tax plan over in Congress, which, as I recall, passed this bill a couple of
sentences.zh: 我没记错的话，国会几周前刚刚通过了这项法案，

sentences.en: weeks ago, probably giving both themselves and the president their biggest legislative victory so far as here.
sentences.zh: 这可能给他们自己和总统带来了迄今为止最大的立法胜利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the bill has passed the House and it's passed the Senate, but it hasn't passed both of them in the same form.
sentences.zh: 所以该法案已经通过了众议院，也通过了参议院，但两院通过的版本并不完全相同。

sentences.en: So the House and Senate have convened a conference committee to work out the differences.
sentences.zh: 因此，众议院和参议院召集了一个协商委员会来解决分歧。

sentences.en: And Wednesday morning, hours before the president takes the podium.
sentences.zh: 就在周三上午，在总统走上讲台前的几个小时，

sentences.en: The last few minutes or so across the news wires from the AP, it now indicates that Republicans in
sentences.zh: 美联社过去几分钟左右播发的滚动新闻表明，众议院共和党人

sentences.en: the House and Republicans in the Senate have at least agreed in principle on a solid reconciled version of the tax reform bill that will move forward.
sentences.zh: 和参议院共和党人至少在原则上达成了一致，就推进税收改革法案达成了一个稳固的调和版本。

sentences.en: There was an announcement that kind of leaked doubt off of Capitol Hill, that there was an agreement in place on a bill that will become,
sentences.zh: 国会山流出了一条消息，称双方已就一项法案达成一致，

sentences.en: they believe, the bill they sent to the president next week.
sentences.zh: 他们相信这将是下周提交给总统签署的法案。

sentences.en: It slashes the top tax rate for the wealthiest individuals to 37 percent and reduces the corporate tax rate to 21 percent.
sentences.zh: 它将最高收入人群的最高税率削减至 37%，并将企业税率降至 21%。

sentences.en: President Trump says businesses and Americans would also see cuts early next year.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，企业和美国民众也将在明年初看到减税。

sentences.en: Jim, this bill passed both the House and the Senate with basically no Democratic support.
sentences.zh: 吉姆，这项法案在几乎没有民主党支持的情况下通过了众议院和参议院。

sentences.en: So what are Democrats now saying about the final appearance of the bill?
sentences.zh: 那么民主党现在对法案的最终面貌有何评价？

sentences.en: Democrats are furious.
sentences.zh: 民主党人愤怒已极。

sentences.en: The American people are witnessing a masterclass in how one political party relying on secrecy, distortion and brute force can muscle an unpopular
sentences.zh: 美国人民正在见证一场教科书般的演练，看一个政党如何依靠保密、歪曲和粗暴的手段，强行通过一项不受欢迎的、

sentences.en: deficit exploding corporate giveaway to passage.
sentences.zh: 导致赤字飙升的向大企业送大礼的法案。

sentences.en: They also are already starting to warn that if deficits increase, Republicans will turn to cutting social safety net programs such as Medicare and Social
sentences.zh: 他们还开始警告称，如果赤字增加，共和党人将转而削减社会安全网项目，例如医疗保险和社会

sentences.en: Security in order to make up the difference and reduce the national debt going forward.
sentences.zh: 保障，以此来弥补差额并减少未来的国债。

sentences.en: And they are warning that that would be essentially another transfer of wealth from poor people who are helped by those
sentences.zh: 他们警告说，这本质上将是财富的又一次转移，从依赖这些项目获得帮助的穷人，

sentences.en: programs to the more wealthy people who are benefiting from these tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 转移到从这些减税中受益的更富裕人群手中。

sentences.en: A final bill will come with an astonishing price tag, and it's bound to do a terrible job getting help to those who need it.
sentences.zh: 最终的法案将伴随着令人咋舌的代价，而且在帮助真正需要的人方面注定会做得很糟糕。

sentences.en: And they're furious because they just won an election in Alabama, and they think that their new
sentences.zh: 他们之所以愤怒，是因为他们刚刚赢得了阿拉巴马州的选举，他们认为他们来自阿拉巴马州的新

sentences.en: Democratic senator from Alabama should be allowed to take his seat before this bill goes forward.
sentences.zh: 民主党参议员应该在这一法案推进之前获准就职。

sentences.en: In light of last night's election, Mr. Chairman, I do not believe that we should be holding today's meeting.
sentences.zh: 鉴于昨晚的选举，主席先生，我认为我们不应该举行今天的会议。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it's imperative that we respect the will of the people of Alabama and delay any further action on this tax bill until Senator-elect Jones can be seated.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为我们当务之急是尊重阿拉巴马州人民的意愿，推迟对这项税收法案的任何进一步行动，直到当选参议员琼斯就职为止。

sentences.en: The Democratic argument is essentially recent history, that in 2010...
sentences.zh: 民主党的论点基本上是借鉴近期历史，即在 2010 年……

sentences.en: Live at 924, Scott Brown is your new Republican senator from the state of Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州选出了新的共和党参议员斯科特·布朗，现场直播于 9 点 24 分进行。

sentences.en: After Senator Ted Kennedy died, there was a special election in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 在参议员泰德·肯尼迪逝世后，马萨诸塞州举行了一场特别选举。

sentences.en: A Republican won it, and when that happened, Democrats stopped the process of passing the Affordable Care Act until he was seated.
sentences.zh: 一名共和党人赢得了选举，当这种情况发生时，民主党人暂停了通过《平价医疗法案》的进程，直到他宣誓就职。

sentences.en: Following the election, we heard strong words from Senator Mitch McConnell, the leader of the
sentences.zh: 选举过后，我们听到了共和党领袖

sentences.en: Republican Party, in which he, quote, stated emphatically, I think the message of the moment is that the American people all across the country
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔参议员的强硬言论，他当时“明确表示，我认为当下的讯息是，全国各地的美国人民，

sentences.en: are asking us, even in the most liberal state, Massachusetts, to stop this health care bill.
sentences.zh: 甚至在最自由派的州——马萨诸塞州，都在要求我们叫停这项医疗法案。”

sentences.en: What did Democrats do?
sentences.zh: 民主党人是怎么做的？

sentences.en: We waited and respected the will of the people of Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 我们等待并尊重了马萨诸塞州人民的意愿。

sentences.en: Quite simply, even when it was hard and against our own politics, Democrats did the right thing and allowed Senator Brown to cast a vote on final passage of the ACA.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，哪怕在局势艰难且违背自身政治利益的时候，民主党人也做出了正确的事情，允许布朗参议员对《平价医疗法案》的最终通过投下赞成票。

sentences.en: I hope we could do the same today.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们今天也能这样做。

sentences.en: And the Republican response is that Senate election in 2010 was entirely about health care.
sentences.zh: 而共和党人的回应是，2010 年的那场参议院选举完全是围绕医疗保健展开的。

sentences.en: And the Roy Moore-Doug Jones race was hardly at all about taxes.
sentences.zh: 而罗伊·穆尔对阵道格·琼斯的竞选几乎跟税收毫无关系。

sentences.en: And there is no reason to stop the process now.
sentences.zh: 现在没有任何理由叫停这一进程。

sentences.en: It's almost over.
sentences.zh: 它快要结束了。

sentences.en: Lame-duck senators vote all the time.
sentences.zh: 跛脚鸭参议员随时都在投票。

sentences.en: They are not seriously considering stopping the bill on those grounds.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有认真考虑以这些理由叫停法案。

sentences.en: As this victory draws closer, I mean, we are so close right now.
sentences.zh: 随着这场胜利越来越近，我的意思是，我们现在离胜利太近了。

sentences.en: So close.
sentences.zh: 太近了。

sentences.en: In fact, almost, I don't want to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，几乎，我都不想谈论它。

sentences.en: Maybe we shouldn't talk about it.
sentences.zh: 也许我们不该谈论它。

sentences.en: In September, the administration and congressional leaders released sort of an outline of their tax plan.
sentences.zh: 9月份，政府和国会领导人公布了他们的税收计划的大致轮廓。

sentences.en: By November, start of November, they had an actual bill in the House.
sentences.zh: 到了 11 月，即 11 月初，他们在众议院提出了实际的法案。

sentences.en: By the middle of November, they had a bill in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 到 11 月中旬，他们在参议院提出了法案。

sentences.en: By the end of November, the very start of December, the bill had passed both the House and the Senate.
sentences.zh: 到 11 月底、12 月初，该法案已在众议院和参议院获得通过。

sentences.en: That is very, very fast, quite possibly the fastest we've seen for a major piece of non-emergency legislation in a really long time.
sentences.zh: 这速度非常非常快，很可能是很长一段时间内我们在一项重大非紧急立法中所见过的最快速度。

sentences.en: And what that speed has done is produce a bill that is likely to get in under the wire of things like this Alabama special election,
sentences.zh: 这种速度带来的结果是，该法案很可能会在阿拉巴马州特别选举等事情发生之前抢先过关，

sentences.en: changing the calculus in Washington and politics.
sentences.zh: 从而改变华盛顿和政治上的盘算。

sentences.en: But it has also yielded a bill that a majority of the public does not like and that a majority of the public thinks will not help them.
sentences.zh: 但它也产出了一部公众多数不喜欢的法案，而且公众多数认为它对自己毫无帮助。

sentences.en: And so there has been a success on the speed, not as much success on the sale.
sentences.zh: 所以在速度上取得了成功，在推销上却没有那么成功。

sentences.en: And now we get to see which one's more important for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要看看对共和党人来说哪一个更重要。

sentences.en: Thank you, Jim.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，吉姆。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: This moment will be forever remembered as a great new beginning, the dawn of a brilliant American future shining with patriotism, prosperity and pride.
sentences.zh: 这一时刻将被永远铭记为一个伟大的新起点，一个闪耀着爱国主义、繁荣与骄傲的辉煌美国未来的曙光。

sentences.en: With your help, we will bring back our jobs.
sentences.zh: 在你们的帮助下，我们将找回我们的工作。

sentences.en: We will bring back our wealth as a country.
sentences.zh: 我们将找回我们作为一个国家的财富。

sentences.en: And for every citizen across this beautiful land, we will bring back our great American dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 为了这片美丽土地上的每一位公民，我们将找回我们伟大的美国梦。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And God bless you all.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝保佑你们所有人。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: It spans the globe like a superhighway.
sentences.zh: 它像一条超级高速公路一样横跨全球。

sentences.en: It sort of evolved through the decades into what we now know as the World Wide Web.
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的发展，它演变成了我们现在所知的万维网。

sentences.en: There's a revolution going on in rec rooms, offices and classrooms around the world.
sentences.zh: 一场变革正在世界各地的娱乐室、办公室和教室里发生。

sentences.en: A revolution in which 15 million people are taking part.
sentences.zh: 一场有 1500 万人参与的变革。

sentences.en: When I became president, there were just 50 websites on the World Wide Web.
sentences.zh: 当我成为总统时，万维网上只有 50 个网站。

sentences.en: Now there are 17 million and almost 50 million households online in the United States alone.
sentences.zh: 现在仅在美国国内就有 1700 万个网站，近 5000 万家庭连入互联网。

sentences.en: They're sharing scientific data, arguing philosophy or passing on cooking tips and gossip.
sentences.zh: 他们在分享科学数据、讨论哲学，或是传递烹饪技巧和八卦。

sentences.en: This sort of open source, decentralized, royalty-free system where anyone can put up anything, everyone has access to the same tools,
sentences.zh: 这种开源、去中心化、免版税的系统，任何人都可以发布任何内容，每个人都能获得相同的工具，

sentences.en: and all data is created equally and treated equally.
sentences.zh: 所有数据都是平等创建并受到平等对待的。

sentences.en: You need a computer and a phone, and suddenly you're part of a new mesh of people, programs, archives, ideas.
sentences.zh: 你只需要一台电脑和一部电话，转眼间你就成了由人、程序、档案和创意构成的新网络的一部分。

sentences.en: So, no one is in control of the Internet, even from the start, and it's envisioned that way.
sentences.zh: 所以，从一开始就没有人控制互联网，最初的设想就是这样的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think the early advocates for the Internet envisioned it as a place where people could be free.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为互联网的早期倡导者将其设想为一个人们可以获得自由的地方。

sentences.en: It was this stateless thing that was outside corporate control that would allow everyone equal footing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无国界的、不受企业控制的事物，它能让每个人站在同一起跑线上。

sentences.en: I mean, who is the CEO of the Internet, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，互联网的首席执行官是谁，对吧？

sentences.en: There is none.
sentences.zh: 根本没有。

sentences.en: There is no one with a sort of red button that they can push to stop the Internet.
sentences.zh: 没有人手里握着那种可以按下去就能叫停互联网的红色按钮。

sentences.en: It is this sort of, by nature, decentralized and open thing.
sentences.zh: 它天生就是一种去中心化且开放的事物。

sentences.en: And when did that start to change?
sentences.zh: 那这种状况是什么时候开始改变的？

sentences.en: I think it started to change in the early 2000s.
sentences.zh: 我认为它在 2000 年代初开始改变。

sentences.en: And one moment that seems particularly crucial is this case in 2005 that involved a small Internet service provider in North Carolina called Madison River Communication.
sentences.zh: 其中一个显得尤为关键的时刻是 2005 年的一起案件，涉及北卡罗来纳州一家名为麦迪逊河通信的小型互联网服务提供商。

sentences.en: They provided high-speed Internet as well as phones and other types of connections to their customers.
sentences.zh: 他们为客户提供高速互联网以及电话和其他类型的连接。

sentences.en: And one of the decisions that they made that was very fateful was to block what's called voice-over Internet protocol services, which are like Internet phone services.
sentences.zh: 他们做出的一个非常命运攸关的决定是屏蔽所谓的网络电话服务，也就是类似互联网电话服务的业务。

sentences.en: Because they made their own phone services, right?
sentences.zh: 因为他们制作了自己的电话服务，对吧？

sentences.en: They wanted their customers to use Madison River phone lines.
sentences.zh: 他们希望客户使用麦迪逊河公司的电话线。

sentences.en: So, they were trying to snuff out the services of a competitor.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们试图扼杀竞争对手的服务。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's what they were trying to do.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们当时试图做的。

sentences.en: And Vonage, remember Vonage?
sentences.zh: 还有 Vonage，还记得 Vonage 吗？

sentences.en: They had these crazy commercials with that, whoo-hoo, whoo-hoo, whoo-hoo.
sentences.zh: 他们拍了那些疯狂的广告，里面有那种“呼——呼，呼——呼，呼——呼”的声音。

sentences.en: Remember that?
sentences.zh: 还记得吗？

sentences.en: They, like, ran on every station.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎在每个电视台都播放广告。

sentences.en: If you've got broadband, you're ready to go.
sentences.zh: 只要你有了宽带，就可以准备开通了。

sentences.en: So, Vonage was this early voice-over Internet protocol company that made an Internet calling service that would sort of bypass your traditional phone line.
sentences.zh: 所以，Vonage 是早期的一家网络电话公司，它制作了一种可以绕过你传统电话线的互联网呼叫服务。

sentences.en: And they had about, they said, 200 customers on Madison River Communications Internet service who were being blocked from using Vonage.
sentences.zh: 他们说，在麦迪逊河通信公司的互联网服务上，大约有 200 名客户在使用 Vonage 时遭到屏蔽。

sentences.en: And they thought, we're being shut out of these people's business just because their Internet service provider has a conflict.
sentences.zh: 他们心想，我们被剥夺了这些客户的业务，仅仅是因为他们的互联网服务提供商存在利益冲突。

sentences.en: They own their own phone service, too.
sentences.zh: 他们自己也拥有电话业务。

sentences.en: And, essentially, you had two ideological camps that open up about how the Internet should function.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，当时出现了两种关于互联网应该如何运作的意识形态阵营。

sentences.en: And one is this sort of dumb pipe theory, which is that the Internet and the way it's delivered to you should be a lot like the running water in your house.
sentences.zh: 其中一种是所谓的哑管道理论，即互联网及其向你交付的方式应该很像你家里的自来水。

sentences.en: You open your tap and water comes out.
sentences.zh: 你打开水龙头，水就流出来了。

sentences.en: You turn on your computer and Internet connection comes out.
sentences.zh: 你打开电脑，互联网连接就通了。

sentences.en: And the pipes that carry that Internet to you shouldn't be able to prioritize certain types of data over others.
sentences.zh: 传输互联网的管道不应该优先处理某些类型的数据而冷落其他数据。

sentences.en: They shouldn't be able to say, this type of video will run at this speed, but this other type of video will run much slower.
sentences.zh: 它们不应该有权决定这种视频以这种速度运行，而另一种视频运行得慢得多。

sentences.en: And you can't access these five sites because we don't like those five sites or we own our own five sites that compete with those five sites.
sentences.zh: 而且你不能访问这五个网站，因为我们不喜欢这五个网站，或者我们拥有与这五个网站竞争的另外五个网站。

sentences.en: That's the dumb pipe theory.
sentences.zh: 这就是哑管道理论。

sentences.en: And Vonage is on that side.
sentences.zh: Vonage 就站在这一边。

sentences.en: They say, we are an Internet-based service provider.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们是一家基于互联网的服务提供商。

sentences.en: Customers should be able to use us regardless of whether their Internet service provider has a competing service.
sentences.zh: 无论他们的互联网服务提供商是否有竞争性的服务，客户都应该能够使用我们。

sentences.en: The other side is Madison River Communications' side, which is, I guess you could call it the smart pipe theory, which is that, hey, we built these pipes.
sentences.zh: 另一边则是麦迪逊河通信公司（Madison River Communications）的立场，我想你可以称之为智能管道理论，也就是，嘿，这些管道是我们建的。

sentences.en: We built the infrastructure that delivers high-speed Internet to our customers.
sentences.zh: 我们建设了向客户提供高速互联网的基础设施。

sentences.en: We have the right to treat data within our system however we want to treat it.
sentences.zh: 我们有权按照我们想要的方式处理系统内的数据。

sentences.en: And if that means shutting off Vonage or other things that compete with our own products, then that's our prerogative.
sentences.zh: 如果这意味着关闭 Vonage 或其他与我们自己的产品竞争的服务，那这就是我们的特权。

sentences.en: And if customers don't like it, they can go out and find someone else to give them Internet.
sentences.zh: 如果客户不喜欢，他们可以去找别人提供互联网服务。

sentences.en: And in the larger ecosystem of the Internet, who sides with the dumb pipe theory and who sides with the smart pipe theory?
sentences.zh: 在更广泛的互联网生态系统中，谁站在哑管道理论一边，谁又站在智能管道理论一边呢？

sentences.en: Well, so it essentially divides into two kinds of businesses, Internet service providers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它基本上分为两类企业，即互联网服务提供商。

sentences.en: So Verizon, AT&T, ComcaSt.
sentences.zh: 比如 Verizon、AT&T、康卡斯特（Comcast）。

sentences.en: These companies naturally want to have control over the services that they build.
sentences.zh: 这些公司自然希望对他们构建的服务拥有控制权。

sentences.en: Because they build pipes.
sentences.zh: 因为管道是他们建的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And their argument is, we spent all this money developing these systeMs.
sentences.zh: 他们的论点是，我们花光了所有资金来开发这些系统。

sentences.en: We should be able to decide how we administer them.
sentences.zh: 我们应该能够决定如何管理它们。

sentences.en: And then you have the companies that create stuff for the Internet.
sentences.zh: 然后是那些为互联网创造内容的的公司。

sentences.en: Your Netflixes, your Googles, Facebooks, all of the companies that rely on the Internet to access their services.
sentences.zh: 像你的 Netflix、谷歌、Facebook，所有依赖互联网来访问其服务的公司。

sentences.en: They use the pipes.
sentences.zh: 他们使用的是这些管道。

sentences.en: They use the pipes, right?
sentences.zh: 他们使用的是管道，对吧？

sentences.en: And so they don't want any data to be prioritized over other data because Netflix doesn't want, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以他们不希望任何数据享有优先权，因为 Netflix 不希望，你知道的，

sentences.en: AT&T to develop its own rival video service and block Netflix from AT&T customers.
sentences.zh: AT&T 开发自己的竞争视频服务，并阻止 Netflix 接触 AT&T 的客户。

sentences.en: So, in the case of Vonage versus Madison River, what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么，在 Vonage 对阵麦迪逊河通信公司的案例中，结果如何呢？

sentences.en: So, Vonage files a complaint with the FCC, who's the regulator who handles communications issues.
sentences.zh: 于是，Vonage 向联邦通信委员会（FCC）提出了投诉，该机构是处理通信问题的监管机构。

sentences.en: And the FCC agrees with them.
sentences.zh: FCC 站在了他们这一边。

sentences.en: They say this is unfair to Vonage's customers.
sentences.zh: 他们表示这对 Vonage 的客户是不公平的。

sentences.en: They settle with Madison River Communication, which agrees to pay $15,000 as a fine and are promised not to do this again.
sentences.zh: 他们与麦迪逊河通信公司达成和解，后者同意支付 15,000 美元作为罚款，并承诺不再这样做。

sentences.en: And this is sort of the first victory for the movement that would become known as net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是后来被称为网络中立性运动的第一次胜利。

sentences.en: Well, the big debate in the United States is over net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 在美国，这场大辩论主要围绕网络中立性展开。

sentences.en: Net neutrality, a policy that forces Internet providers to treat all web traffic equally.
sentences.zh: 网络中立性是一项迫使互联网提供商平等对待所有网络流量的政策。

sentences.en: So, how much control should the government have over web traffic and Internet commerce and profits?
sentences.zh: 那么，政府对网络流量、互联网商业和利润应该拥有多大的控制权？

sentences.en: So, this ruling sets a precedent in the world of Internet providers that they shouldn't block or slow down in any way any content on the Internet from getting to a customer.
sentences.zh: 因此，这项裁决在互联网服务提供商的世界里开创了一个先例，即他们不得以任何方式阻止或减慢互联网上的任何内容到达客户的速度。

sentences.en: Is that the essence of net neutrality?
sentences.zh: 这难道就是网络中立性的精髓吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that's what net neutrality advocates want.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是网络中立性倡导者想要的东西。

sentences.en: And that's what they've been trying to uphold, you know, in the 12 years since that happened.
sentences.zh: 这也是他们（你知道的）在过去 12 年里一直在努力捍卫的东西。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Everybody, ever since the Internet was created, it's been organized around basic principles of openness, fairness, and freedom.
sentences.zh: 各位，自从互联网诞生以来，它一直围绕着开放、公平和自由的基本原则构建。

sentences.en: There are no gatekeepers deciding which sites you get to access.
sentences.zh: 没有任何守门人来决定你可以访问哪些网站。

sentences.en: There are no toll roads on the information superhighway.
sentences.zh: 信息高速公路上没有收费站。

sentences.en: This set of principles, the idea of net neutrality, has unleashed the power of the Internet and given innovators the chance to thrive.
sentences.zh: 这套原则，也就是网络中立性的理念，释放了互联网的力量，并为创新者提供了蓬勃发展的机会。

sentences.en: Abandoning these principles would threaten to end the Internet as we know it.
sentences.zh: 抛弃这些原则将威胁到我们所熟知的互联网的终结。

sentences.en: In 2015, the FCC, under the Obama administration, essentially votes to codify net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 在 2015 年，奥巴马政府领导下的 FCC 基本上通过投票将网络中立性法典化。

sentences.en: The FCC has just approved the net neutrality rules by a vote of 3 to 2.
sentences.zh: FCC 刚刚以 3 比 2 的投票结果批准了网络中立性规则。

sentences.en: That's as was expected here, but we had some...
sentences.zh: 这正如这里所预料的那样，但我们也有一些……

sentences.en: This is what democracy looks like.
sentences.zh: 这就是民主的样子。

sentences.en: It was the end of a long, hard-fought battle over the future of the Internet.
sentences.zh: 这是一场关于互联网未来的漫长而艰难的战斗的结束。

sentences.en: With this strict, open Internet order that says you can't block sites or apps, you can't have paid fast lanes where certain types of data get to move faster than others,
sentences.zh: 凭借这一严格的、开放的互联网秩序——它规定你不能阻止网站或应用程序，你不能设立付费快车道让某些类型的数据比其他数据移动得更快——

sentences.en: it's really the first comprehensive update to the rules that govern the Internet.
sentences.zh: 这确实是对管理互联网规则的首次全面更新。

sentences.en: They're essentially saying this is not a toy anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在说，这不再是一个玩具了。

sentences.en: This is a utility.
sentences.zh: 这是一项公共事业。

sentences.en: This is like the phone system, like the highways, like electricity.
sentences.zh: 这就像电话系统、高速公路和电力一样。

sentences.en: This is a crucial piece of how we operate as a society.
sentences.zh: 这是我们作为一个社会运作的关键部分。

sentences.en: So let's revisit the battle lines that we started to describe in 2005.
sentences.zh: 让我们重新审视我们在 2005 年开始描述的战线。

sentences.en: Have they changed since then in terms of who supports regulating the Internet and who opposes it?
sentences.zh: 就谁支持监管互联网、谁反对监管而言，它们自那时起发生变化了吗？

sentences.en: Sort of.
sentences.zh: 算是吧。

sentences.en: I mean, you still have the basic dynamic of the companies that create content for the Internet, wanting the Internet to be a neutral platform.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你仍然拥有基本的动态，即为互联网创造内容的公司希望互联网成为一个中立的平台。

sentences.en: And then you still have the Internet service providers who want to be able to control how their services are used.
sentences.zh: 然后你仍然有那些希望能够控制其服务使用方式的互联网服务 providers（服务提供商）。

sentences.en: But then you also have all these weird sort of amalgamations and hybrids.
sentences.zh: 但随后你也有了所有这些奇怪的融合和混合体。

sentences.en: So, for example, Google, which is a search engine and content company, now also has an Internet service provider, Google Fiber, that people can use to get Internet in some cities.
sentences.zh: 例如，既是搜索引擎又是内容公司的谷歌，现在也有了一个互联网服务提供商——谷歌光纤（Google Fiber），人们可以在某些城市使用它来接入互联网。

sentences.en: On the other side, you have companies like Comcast, which is an Internet service provider, but also owns NBC.
sentences.zh: 在另一边，你拥有像康卡斯特这样的公司，它是一家互联网服务提供商，但同时也拥有 NBC。

sentences.en: So they're in the content business as well.
sentences.zh: 所以他们也涉足了内容业务。

sentences.en: So the whole debate has just gotten a lot more cloudy, and the battle lines aren't really as clear now.
sentences.zh: 因此，整个辩论变得更加模糊，战线现在也不是那么清晰了。

sentences.en: Mr. President, later on today, the Senate will move to a vote to advance the nomination of Ajit Pai to become chairman of the Federal Communications Commission.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，今天晚些时候，参议院将投票推进阿吉特·帕伊（Ajit Pai）担任联邦通信委员会主席的提名。

sentences.en: So in January, newly inaugurated President Donald Trump installs Ajit Pai as the head of the FCC.
sentences.zh: 因此在 1 月份，新就职的总统唐纳德·特朗普任命阿吉特·帕伊为 FCC 负责人。

sentences.en: He is working to establish the light-touch regulatory framework that allowed the Internet to become the marvel of the modern age.
sentences.zh: 他正致力于建立轻触式监管框架，正是这种框架让互联网成为了现代社会的奇迹。

sentences.en: And Ajit Pai is a guy who was on the FCC in 2015 and disagreed with their decision to codify net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 阿吉特·帕伊正是 2015 年在 FCC 任职并不同意他们将网络中立性法典化决定的那个人。

sentences.en: And I'm opposed to President Obama's plan for Internet regulation precisely because it is going to make for slower broadband for Americans,
sentences.zh: 我反对奥巴马总统的互联网监管计划，正是因为它将给美国人带来更慢的宽带，

sentences.en: increase their Internet bills, and ultimately will reduce competition and innovation in the broadband marketplace.
sentences.zh: 增加他们的上网账单，并最终会减少宽带市场中的竞争和创新。

sentences.en: So in November, he unveils this plan to repeal net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 因此在 11 月份，他公布了这项废除网络中立性的计划。

sentences.en: And what is Ajit Pai's argument for rolling back what started off as a kind of informal understanding,
sentences.zh: 阿吉特·帕伊废除这种最初作为一种非正式谅解、

sentences.en: but one that was well-honored and then has become codified officially by the FCC, net neutrality?
sentences.zh: 但广受尊重随后又被 FCC 正式法典化的制度——网络中立性的理由是什么？

sentences.en: What's his problem with it and the argument for rolling it back?
sentences.zh: 他对其有什么意见，以及他废除它的论据是什么？

sentences.en: So his argument is essentially that in the years when the Internet was being built into the amazing and wonderful thing it is today,
sentences.zh: 他的论据基本上是，在互联网被构建成今天这个令人惊叹和奇妙事物的那些年里，

sentences.en: that we didn't have these rules, that it was a much more lightly regulated sector.
sentences.zh: 我们并没有这些规则，那是一个监管轻得多的行业。

sentences.en: And under that light regulation, it flourished and thrived and grew into what it is.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种轻度监管下，它繁荣发展并成长为今天的样子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So there's a camp that says the Internet is freer when it is more regulated.
sentences.zh: 所以有一个阵营认为，互联网在受到更多监管时才更自由。

sentences.en: And then there are people like Ajit Pai who say, actually, no, the Internet is freer when it is freer.
sentences.zh: 然后还有像阿吉特·帕伊这样的人，他们说，其实不然，互联网在更自由的时候才更自由。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Ajit Pai would say, you know, the 2015 decision was an example of government overreach and micromanaging this sort of free and open space.
sentences.zh: 阿吉特·帕伊会说，你知道的，2015 年的决定是政府权力过大并微观管理这个自由开放空间的一个例子。

sentences.en: And I think the net neutrality advocates would say, well,
sentences.zh: 我想网络中立性的倡导者会说，嗯，

sentences.en: the thing that has kept the Internet free and open is this understanding that net neutrality was an important thing to preserve and uphold.
sentences.zh: 正是这种认为网络中立性是需要保护和维护的重要事物的共识，才让互联网保持了自由和开放。

sentences.en: New tonight, protesters across the country are demanding neutrality.
sentences.zh: 今晚最新消息，全国各地的抗议者都在要求中立。

sentences.en: They're fighting against a proposed move by the FCC, which would seriously change the Internet as we know it.
sentences.zh: 他们正在反对 FCC 提议的一项举措，该举措将彻底改变我们所熟知的互联网。

sentences.en: I feel like net neutrality is more than just the Internet being equal.
sentences.zh: 我觉得网络中立性不仅仅意味着互联网的平等。

sentences.en: It's how we express ourselves.
sentences.zh: 它是我们表达自我的方式。

sentences.en: It's fear of speech.
sentences.zh: 它是言论自由。

sentences.en: Well, today, some of the biggest tech companies like Facebook and Google are participating in what they call a day of action.
sentences.zh: 今天，像 Facebook 和谷歌这样的一些最大科技公司正在参加他们所谓的行动日。

sentences.en: It is a protest of the FCC's plan to roll back Obama-era net neutrality rules.
sentences.zh: 这是对 FCC 废除奥巴马时代网络中立性规则计划的抗议。

sentences.en: What's the fear among proponents of net neutrality about what this proposal from President Trump's FCC will do?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的 FCC 的这一提议会带来什么，网络中立性的支持者对此最大的担忧是什么？

sentences.en: How exactly do they think this decision might change the Internet for the worse?
sentences.zh: 他们究竟认为这个决定会如何朝着坏的方向改变互联网？

sentences.en: Well, I think the darkest vision of this future Internet that people are scared of is that it will become essentially a pay-to-play scheme,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为人们对这个未来互联网最黑暗的恐惧是，它基本上会变成一个付费才能玩的方案，

sentences.en: that you'll get up one morning and try to go watch a movie on your favorite website, and it'll say, you know, in order to do this, you have to upgrade your package
sentences.zh: 你会发现在某天早晨醒来，当你试图在你最喜欢的网站上看电影时，它会提示你，你知道的，为了做到这一点，你必须升级你的套餐，

sentences.en: because that website actually isn't included with our basic Internet package.
sentences.zh: 因为那个网站实际上并不包含在我们的基础互联网套餐中。

sentences.en: or that you'll be slowed down when trying to visit certain types of websites because your Internet service provider has a business relationship with competing websites.
sentences.zh: 或者当你试图访问某些类型的网站时，你的访问速度会被放慢，因为你的互联网服务提供商与竞争网站有商业关系。

sentences.en: And the larger worry is that the companies that we all know and love today, Facebook, Google, Netflix, they all came of age because of net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 更大的担忧是，我们今天熟知并喜爱的公司——Facebook、谷歌、Netflix，它们都是因为网络中立性而成熟的。

sentences.en: They were able to grow and flourish because these principles were in place.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这些原则的存在，它们才得以成长和繁荣。

sentences.en: So the worry is that the sort of next generation of cool companies that no one's heard of yet, they won't have a fair playing field to compete against the giants
sentences.zh: 所以人们担心的是，那些没人听说过的下一代酷公司将无法在一个公平的竞技场上与这些巨头竞争，

sentences.en: because net neutrality won't exist to protect them.
sentences.zh: 因为网络中立性将不复存在来保护它们。

sentences.en: Kevin, let's say net neutrality is rolled back as Ajit Pai and the Trump administration want.
sentences.zh: 凯文（Kevin），假设网络中立性正如阿吉特·帕伊和特朗普政府所愿被废除了。

sentences.en: Is it possible that the Internet will change in a way where it can't go back to this idealistic democratic place where it started?
sentences.zh: 互联网有没有可能发生改变，以至于再也无法回到它最初那个理想主义的民主状态？

sentences.en: That even if you reimpose net neutrality down the line with the next president after Trump, that something essential about the Internet will have been lost?
sentences.zh: 即使你在未来某个时候在特朗普之后的下一任总统任上重新实施网络中立性，互联网的一些本质东西也已经失去了？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that's totally possible.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这完全有可能。

sentences.en: But I think there's something that a lot of people are missing here, which is that the Internet has already lost that open democratic quality.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很多人忽略了一点，那就是互联网已经失去了那种开放的民主品质。

sentences.en: We now have these giant Silicon Valley tech companies, these platforms that control much, if not most, of what people experience as the Internet.
sentences.zh: 我们现在拥有这些巨大的硅谷科技公司，这些平台控制着人们作为互联网体验的大部分，即使不是绝大部分。

sentences.en: And they are not under the sort of thumb of net neutrality.
sentences.zh: 它们并不受网络中立性的约束。

sentences.en: They are not guided by these regulatory changes.
sentences.zh: 它们不受这些监管变化的引导。

sentences.en: And so in a way, the Internet has already lost some of the initial qualities that its founders envisioned.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，互联网已经失去了一些其创立者最初设想的品质。

sentences.en: The Internet is not a sort of free and level playing field for everyone.
sentences.zh: 互联网并不是一个对所有人而言都自由且平等的竞技场。

sentences.en: And this could make it worse, or it could just continue the trend.
sentences.zh: 这可能会使情况变得更糟，或者它只是延续了这种趋势。

sentences.en: Thank you, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯文。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Today, the Federal Communications Commission is scheduled to vote on a measure to undo the regulations put in place under President Obama.
sentences.zh: 今天，联邦通信委员会计划就一项旨在取消奥巴马总统时期制定的规章的议案进行投票。

sentences.en: Of the five commissioners on the FCC, three are Republican, and the rollback is expected to pass by a 3-2 margin along party lines.
sentences.zh: 在 FCC 的五位委员中，三位是共和党人，预计该废除议案将以 3 比 2 的党派分歧票数获得通过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Lieutenant Governor Tina Smith of Minnesota will take over for Al Franken in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 明尼苏达州副州长蒂娜·史密斯（Tina Smith）将接替艾尔·弗兰肯（Al Franken）进入美国参议院，

sentences.en: Senate, keeping a Democrat in the seat for now, but setting the stage for a big election in 2018.
sentences.zh: 目前为民主党人保住了这个席位，但也为 2018 年的大选做好了铺垫。

sentences.en: During the midterms, voters in Minnesota will vote for a candidate to fill the remaining two years of Franken's term.
sentences.zh: 在期中选举期间，明尼苏达州的选民将投票选出一名候选人来填补弗兰肯任期剩下的两年。

sentences.en: And Smith has said she'll run to stay in the seat in that election.
sentences.zh: 史密斯已经表示她将参选，以便在那次选举中保留这个席位。

sentences.en: And four women have accused the music mogul Russell Simmons of violent sexual behavior, with three of the women saying that he raped them, in incidents spanning from 1988 to 2014.
sentences.zh: 四名女性指控音乐大亨拉塞尔·西蒙斯（Russell Simmons）存在暴力性行为，其中三名女性称遭到他的强奸，事件跨度从 1988 年到 2014 年。

sentences.en: Last month, Simmons had stepped down from his companies and apologized for being, quote, thoughtless and insensitive.
sentences.zh: 上个月，西蒙斯已辞去其公司的职务，并为自己被形容为轻率和麻木不仁的行为道歉。

sentences.en: But Simmons is denying these latest accounts, first reported by the Times, saying these horrific accusations have shocked me to my core,
sentences.zh: 但西蒙斯正在否认这些最新说法，这些说法最初是由《泰晤士报》报道的，他称这些可怕的指控让我感到震惊，

sentences.en: and all of my relations have been consensual.
sentences.zh: 并且我所有的关系都是双方自愿的。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日秀》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《剪切机秀》（The Wirecutter Show）中，我们正准备迎接节假日的聚会招待。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 请收听有关如何让您的客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会不会为了睡觉而昏迷过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听的任何地方找到《剪切机秀》（The Wirecutter Show）。

sentences.en: The Wirecutter Show on The Wirecutter Show on The Wirecutter Show on The Wirecutter?
sentences.zh: 《剪切机秀》（The Wirecutter Show）！
